data.name: Gether! Kitty!
data.detailed_description:
A puzzle game where Blocky Cats step up to save the world!

In the year 2333, humanity’s misuse of the 'Space-Time Resonator' tears apart the fabric of reality, forming terrifying space-time rifts that devour cities and living beings.

At the critical moment, a group of Blocky Cats from the 'Dimensional Gap' appears — their bodies made of malleable blocks that can freely combine. They fit together with precision, like giant 'band-aids' sealing the rifts, absorbing the chaotic space-time currents, and glowing with a faint shimmer.

The Blocky Cats show off their skills!

Combine! When cats get close to each other, they can fit together like Tetris blocks. Once combined, the cats become a single unit and move together as one.

Defy gravity! By changing the direction of gravity, the cats can walk freely on any wall surface, allowing them to reach more places.

Cat's light-footed skill! Cats will fall from great heights! Cats generally possess the ability to land safely after falling from high places — defying Newtonian gravity and overturning the laws of physics.

Goal! Combine into the specified shape, reach the designated position, and seal the space-time rift to win the game!

More members join the cause!

Global celebration: Mewsk weeps with joy as the world erupts in celebration. The feat is broadcast live from Times Square, and cries of 'Thank you, cats!' echo around the globe. The United Nations awards them the 'Cosmic Peace Medal.' The Statue of Victory is replaced with a dynamic 'Cat-Combining Sculpture,' and the 'University of Combining Cats' is established.

More Blocky Cats (such as Rocket Cat and Conductive Cat) join the battle, each with their own unique abilities, writing a legend of salvation.

Nuclear-Powered Rocket Cat! Using rocket technology, this cat can move forward continuously, defying gravity! Only a hard landing can stop it. Don't worry — its space suit comes with a super-strong crash protection feature! And much more!

Travel and adventure through diverse, cartoonish, and fantastical worlds!

Cute Q-style cartoon art: The visual style is primarily based on blocky structures, with themes covering beaches, the Backrooms, pool cores, deserts, and more. Rich in elements and harmoniously colored, the game offers players a relaxing puzzle-solving experience while enjoying delightful audiovisual effects.

Each chapter features a unique mechanic: Solve meticulously designed levels to save the world. The levels are divided into normal stages and challenge stages. Completing challenge stages rewards you with skin unlocks, allowing you to collect even more cats!

The world belongs to cats! Cats save the world! 🎉🎉🎉🎉

data.short_description: In the year 2333, humanity’s misuse of an unknown force tore open spatial rifts. Blocky Cats stepped forward, assembling themselves into various shapes to plug the rifts with their own bodies, saving the world and ushering in the Era of the Blocky Cats.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3

  • Storage: 1000 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
